eligibility_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women recruited at their first prenatal visit before the 19th week of gestation.
* Participants from Ille-et-Vilaine, Côtes d’Armor and Finistère departments.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Children born before the 35th week of gestation.
* Children with a genetic or chromosomic disease.
* Children who had suffered severe head trauma during childhood.
* Children treated on a regular or prolonged basis with tranquilizers, anti-depressant or psychostimulant neuroleptic drugs.
* Women who did not work during pregnancy.

* Women who changed jobs during pregnancy.

Inclusion Criteria:

* Age between 18-85 years
* Diagnosis of stage I-IV non-Hodgkin’s or Hodgkin’s lymphoma
* Receipt of anthracycline-based chemotherapy or other potentially cardiotoxic cancer therapies
* Self-reported capacity to walk at least 2 city blocks (~ 650 feet/200 m) on a flat surface
* Ability to speak and understand English
* Survival beyond 6 months

Exclusion Criteria:

* Uncontrolled hypertension (systolic blood pressure > 190 mmHg or diastolic blood pressure > 100 mmHg)
* Recent history of alcohol or drug abuse
* Contraindication for magnetic resonance imaging (Magnetic Resonance Imaging)
* Contraindications for exercise training or testing
* Inability to exercise on stationary cycle
* Claustrophobia
* Unstable angina
* Pregnancy
* Moving within 12 months of enrollment
* Inability to provide informed consent

Inclusion Criteria:

* Participants with severe asthma under the care of a respirologist
* Participants with a diagnosis of severe asthma in accordance with the Global Initiative for Asthma treatment step criteria
* Participants who completed research assessments at St. Joseph’s Healthcare Hamilton (Hamilton, ON, Canada)
* Participants who provided demographic information, reported their asthma control and quality of life using the 5-point Asthma Control Questionnaire and Asthma Quality of Life Questionnaire, and performed spirometry and hyperpolarized 129Xe ventilation Magnetic Resonance Imaging after bronchodilator administration
* Participants who provided sputum for cytometry on the same day as ventilation Magnetic Resonance Imaging

Exclusion Criteria:

* Participants younger than 18 years old
* Participants older than 65 years old
* Participants who did not complete research assessments at St. Joseph’s Healthcare Hamilton (Hamilton, ON, Canada)
* Participants who did not provide demographic information, report their asthma control and quality of life, perform spirometry, or undergo hyperpolarized 129Xe ventilation Magnetic Resonance Imaging after bronchodilator administration
* Participants who did not provide sputum for cytometry

Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients diagnosed with nonkeratinizing squamous cell carcinoma confirmed by histopathology
* Pretreatment DECT was performed

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who had received antitumor treatment before DECT examination

Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with symptoms/signs of heart failure

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with previous cardiac imaging indicating significant coronary artery disease
* Patients with severe pulmonary disease (i.e. Forced Expiratory Volume in 1 Second < 50% predicted)
* Patients with cardiomyopathy
* Patients with constrictive pericarditis
* Patients with contraindication to contrast-enhanced Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging study
* Patients with estimated glomerular filtration rate (Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate) < 30 mL/min/1.73 m2
* Patients with more than moderate valvular disease

Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with a recent diagnosis or chronic sarcoidosis
* Patients who are not currently receiving systemic corticosteroid, hydroxychloroquine sulphate or immunosuppressive therapy
* Patients who do not have diabetes, urinary tract infection or urinary lithiasis at the time of sampling, and do not have renal insufficiency

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients under the age of 18 years
* Patients who have a history of systemic corticosteroid, hydroxychloroquine sulphate or immunosuppressive therapy in the previous 6 months
* Patients who are currently receiving a standard treatment regimen, including recent treatments such as antibiotics
* Patients who have a history of diabetes, urinary tract infection or urinary lithiasis at the time of sampling, or renal insufficiency

* Patients with suspected head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) who are being evaluated with a clinically indicated neck Magnetic Resonance Imaging
* Participants who are able to provide written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with heart failure New York Heart Association stages II-IV
* Patients with severe mental illness

* Participants who are not able to complete the Magnetic Resonance Imaging-specific anxiety questionnaire

Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with equivocal CT findings
* Patients with cystic lesions

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not specified
